items.q: What should you remember about **Health futures framing**?
items.a: **everyone has multiple possible futures;** lifestyle picks which; young people have longest runway but worst trends.

items.q: What should you remember about **Maturity-onset diabetes renamed**?
items.a: **T2D in under-55s was** unknown in 1986 Unwin practice; now patients under 25.

items.q: What should you remember about **Insulin as storage hormone**?
items.a: **pushes glucose out of blood** into cells; excess → fat (belly + liver); not just "middle-age spread".

items.q: What should you remember about **Mrs. Jones epiphany (2012)**?
items.a: **patient off metformin via low** carb; "bread is sugar"; 40,000 online learners rubbished by professionals; Unwin ashamed.

items.q: What should you remember about **GP payment incentive**?
items.a: **metformin compliance quotas part** of pay; conflict with patient-led remission.

items.q: What should you remember about **2013 Monday-night cohort**?
items.a: **18 volunteers + Unwin + Jen +** nurse Heather (unpaid); liver function improved 33–50% in weeks; weight, BP, HbA1c followed; hunger vanished.

items.q: What should you remember about **Eat less move more failure**?
items.a: **Unwin blamed patients 25 years; All-Bran** + skim milk advice; Belsen analogy shame; exercise undervalued until low carb.

items.q: What should you remember about **Nutrition literacy gap**?
items.a: **successful adults ask if 12" pizza** beats Nando's chicken; Premier League star thinks carbonara is health food from carb-loading era.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sugar all day**?
items.a: **cereal + OJ + snacks + sandwich** + cake + pizza = sugar on sugar; snacking epidemic; thin kids on snacks lack protein.

items.q: What should you remember about **Dried fruit trap**?
items.a: 60–70% sugar marketed as fruit; **nova food classification** halo.

items.q: What should you remember about **Orange juice / smoothies**?
items.a: **fast sugar hit →** insulin spike → crash → hunger; Unwin's biscuit panic-attack loop.

items.q: What should you remember about **White chocolate ~80% sugar**?
items.a: **chocoholics addicted to sugar** not cocoa; 90% dark ~2 tsp vs milk chocolate.
